title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before which of these is wudhu required? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Eating
   C. Sleeping only
   D. Playing

2. Why should Muslims not overeat? (1 mark)
   A. It can make us sick and lazy
   B. It makes us fast
   C. It saves money
   D. It is a sport

3. What does "Qalam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pen
   B. Book
   C. Cave
   D. Sword

4. What should a Muslim say before starting to read the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   B. Only Allahu Akbar
   C. Only Alhamdulillah
   D. Nothing at all

5. Malakul Maut takes souls (1 mark)
   A. Only at night
   B. By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   C. Only from old people
   D. Whenever he likes

6. Why do we wash our hands before eating? (1 mark)
   A. To waste water
   B. To keep food and ourselves clean
   C. To make the meal longer
   D. It is only for adults

7. What is the Night of the first revelation often connected with? (1 mark)
   A. Eid
   B. Mawlid
   C. Laylat al-Qadr
   D. Hajj

8. Which of these is a skill that can bring honest income later? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Lying
   C. Stealing
   D. Tailoring

9. Which prophet is linked with honesty and truthfulness in hard times, including prison? (1 mark)
   A. Yusuf
   B. Hud
   C. Lut
   D. Ayyub

10. What is begging? (1 mark)
   A. Asking for money or things without real need
   B. Working
   C. Farming
   D. Saving

11. How is a light najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it
   B. Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   C. Burn it
   D. Wash seven times with soil

12. Which is a bad habit toward relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Helping them
   B. Visiting them
   C. Greeting them
   D. Gossiping about them

13. What is a mukhaffafah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A pure thing
   B. A light najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A heavy najasa

14. Which prophet is famous for patience during illness? (1 mark)
   A. Hud
   B. Ayyub
   C. Dawud
   D. Yusuf

15. Which part is washed first in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Hands
   B. Head
   C. Feet
   D. Ears

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health. (4 marks)

17. Describe three Islamic manners to observe during games. (3 marks)

18. State four duties of children to their parents. (4 marks)

19. Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Prayer
   Prayer needs wudhu.

2. A — It can make us sick and lazy
   Moderation keeps us healthy.

3. A — Pen
   Allah taught by the pen.

4. A — Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   This is the recommended way to begin recitation.

5. B — By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   Nothing happens without Allah's decree.

6. B — To keep food and ourselves clean
   Cleanliness is part of good manners and health.

7. C — Laylat al-Qadr
   Surah 97 speaks about it.

8. D — Tailoring
   Tailoring is a skill.

9. A — Yusuf
   The Qur'an calls Yusuf "Siddiq".

10. A — Asking for money or things without real need
   Begging is asking without need.

11. B — Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   Sprinkling is enough.

12. D — Gossiping about them
   Gossip breaks ties.

13. B — A light najasa
   Mukhaffafah means light.

14. B — Ayyub
   Ayyub was tested with illness and stayed patient.

15. A — Hands
   The hands are washed first.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dress modestly, keep the times of prayer, avoid cheating and insults, respect others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Obey in good, respect, thank and make dua, help at home, care for them when old, be honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.
